Shade: variants per 5 kb (darker = more). Triangles: coding sites. Founders: C BALB/cByJ, B C57BL/6NJ, H C3H/HeJ, D DBA/2J.

UM-HET3 has no markers in this window. At its nearest (4.3 and 6.2 Mb), females' median signed −log10 P over T20–T860 is -2.5 and -2.4 paternal (H longer),
